arena.version_note: The exact Git revision is authoritative; the YAM adapter documentation targets Arena 0.3.1.

reference_geometry.note: Procedural approximation, not manufacturer CAD. SICK sensor and bracket envelopes, Omron E39-L261 clamp and published 3.0–3.5 N m tightening requirement, explicit custom adapter. Contact coefficients, thread compression, mass distribution and passive cable load are estimated. Numerical tool load-path calibration is included; physical hardware calibration has not been performed. Seated hex engagement is approximated by a native sliding key with axial withdrawal; no hand attachment.
reference_geometry.tool: Dimensioned 120 mm lever with native 10 N m/rad spring, 8.1 mm AF socket and calibrated magnifying dial; generic construction, no commercial tool CAD
